final:
-- Spec phase: helper declaration and the parity contract.

ones(x: u8) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= 8
  ex ones(0) == 0
  ex ones(255) == 8
  var v = x
  var count = 0
  for i in range(0, 8)
    if v % 2 == 1
      count += 1
    v = v // 2
  count

parity(x: u8) -> bool =
  post out == (ones(x) % 2 == 1)
  ex parity(1) == True
  ex parity(3) == False
  ones(x) % 2 == 1

test_parity() =
  assert parity(0) == False
  assert parity(1) == True
  assert parity(3) == False
  assert parity(255) == False
  assert parity(7) == True
